quote: Every vehicle driven upon a divided highway must be driven only upon the right-hand roadway and must not be driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section or make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn, except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority.

activation.condition: A vehicle is driven upon a source-reviewed divided highway.

obligation.description: Drive only upon the right-hand roadway; do not cross the divider or make a prohibited turn outside an applicable exception.

exceptions.source_clause: except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space
exceptions.description: Physical opening exception, source geometry required

exceptions.source_clause: at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority
exceptions.description: Crossover or intersection administrative establishment requires separate source

timing.description: Observe original approach, every U-turn movement, and departure.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Roadway direction and boundaries excluding shoulders need reviewed map sources and observed body occupancy.
An authored crossover or intersection label does not establish an administrative fact.

parameter_refs.name: movement_sequence
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: continuous forward versus realized reverse then forward

parameter_refs.name: destination_roadway
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source versus destination right-hand roadway occupancy

parameter_refs.name: authority_establishment
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: separately reviewed crossover or intersection source
